title: thermaestro-cap 0.1
description: One message between the Thermaestro core and a plugin; over a socket, one message per line.

Arming.description: A setting that must be in place before the lever works, restored at release.
Arming.title: Arming

Auth.description:
Over TCP, the plugin's first line. Without it, or with the wrong token, the core
closes the connection without answering.
Auth.title: Auth

CompetingFeature.description: A device or route feature that moves the same thing as the lever.
CompetingFeature.title: CompetingFeature

Delivery.description: How a point's values arrive: pushed unasked, polled at a cost, or on change.
Delivery.title: Delivery

Described.description:
The device tree, every point and lever, and the series. The answer to `describe`
carries its `id` and is complete; sent unasked, it carries the changed parts only.
Described.title: Described

Envelope.description: One value, as every read, subscription and verification delivers it.
Envelope.title: Envelope

Error.description:
A plugin's answer to a request it can't serve. Requests with their own way to fail
don't use it: a read of an unknown point answers with quality unknown, and an act on
an unknown lever ends with fate dropped.
Error.title: Error

Fate.description:
What became of an `act`, as far as the route can know. Accepted isn't applied:
whether a change took is the core's to decide.
Fate.title: Fate

ForeignWrite.description: Another client wrote a datapoint, where the route can see it.
ForeignWrite.title: ForeignWrite

Hello.description:
Opens a connection: the core says it first, and the plugin answers with its own.
Major versions must match; minor differences are handled by `features`, of which the
core uses only those both list.
Hello.title: Hello

Identity.description: A unit's identity. The core keys learned knowledge on plugin, model and firmware.
Identity.title: Identity

OnLapse.description: What the device does when a lease lapses.
OnLapse.title: OnLapse

Presence.description:
How a node is known to exist. Never from "the register answers": some pumps answer
for hardware that isn't fitted.
Presence.title: Presence

Promises.description: What a route can know and guarantee, so the core can plan reads and trust results.
Promises.title: Promises

Read.description:
With `after`, only values sampled after that time: what a fresh read after a write
needs. A route that can't tell answers with `t_observed` null.
Read.title: Read

RuleRecord.description: A grid rule as data, each parameter with what is known about it.
RuleRecord.title: RuleRecord

SeriesInfo.description: A series a plugin offers: a layer of the price stack, a grid rule or a forecast.
SeriesInfo.title: SeriesInfo

SeriesUpdate.description: New intervals, or a revision of published ones.
SeriesUpdate.title: SeriesUpdate

Subscribe.description: Updates on points, from pushes where the route has them and polls otherwise.
Subscribe.title: Subscribe

Unsubscribe.description: Ends the subscription whose `id` it carries.
Unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe

Verify.description: How a result can be checked: read back, watch an effect, or not at all.
Verify.title: Verify

Window.description: A call limit: at most `calls` in any `per_s` seconds.
Window.title: Window
